source: Independent Supabase read-only count: published grade 1-3 activities of published lessons across 22 countries
bug: Student UI inferred multiselect from options.length>3, potentially grading an accidentally selected second option wrong, even when the private grading spec is single-choice.
patch: Set multi mode only for explicit public activity_type=multi_select or allowMultiple/allow_multiple/multi_select/selectionMode=multiple/selection_mode=multiple. Never infer by option count or reveal answer.
